techParks.name: 360 Business Park
techParks.description: New Grade A office park in Electronic City Phase 1 where TCS leased ~1.4 msf (Towers 5A and 5B) for 15 years in August 2025, with phased occupation from April and August 2026. Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: 37 Cunningham
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: AKR Tech Park
aliases: AKR Tech Park, Krishna Reddy Industrial Area
techParks.description: A small office park in the Krishna Reddy Industrial Area off Hosur Road at Kudlu Gate, Bommanahalli (not on the ORR). It is best known as Myntra's former headquarters; OSM still carries a building named 'Myntra Designs Pvt Ltd' here, but Myntra moved its head office to Embassy TechVillage well before 2023, so no Myntra office is recorded at AKR in the companies list. A BHIVE coworking centre operates on the Hosur Road frontage.

techParks.name: Alembic City
techParks.description: Alembic's mixed-use campus on Whitefield-Hoskote Road at Kadugodi. Google IT Services India leased about 650,000 sq ft here in October 2024 and by early 2026 held rights to about 2.4-2.6 million sq ft (Annex Tower, Office Block Towers B and G reserved for it).

techParks.name: AMR Tech Park
techParks.description: Multi-block Grade-A campus at No. 23 & 24 Hosur Road, Hongasandra (Bommanahalli) 560068, with Blocks 1, 2A/2B, 3A/3B and 4A/4B built from about 2012: the head office of Tally Solutions, headquarters of Sagility and Clear (ClearTax), Quinnox's India centre, and OSM-recorded offices of HGS, MetricStream, Avaya, Mindteck, Mando Softtech and Visionet. Cognizant, Lowe's, Mphasis and Yokogawa were checked and NOT found here.

techParks.name: Anjaneya Techno Park
techParks.description: A small commercial building (No. 147) on HAL Old Airport Road beside Diamond District. Zoomcar Holdings' SEC filings give 'Anjaneya Techno Park, No. 147, 1st Floor, Kodihalli' as its business address.

techParks.name: Attibele Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB estate on Hosur Road just short of the Karnataka-Tamil Nadu border at Attibele (OSM way/1119637972), with about 150 mapped plots of auto-component, granite, chemical and engineering units. Michell Bearings (plot 8D) and Sandhar (plots 7A and 12-C) are confirmed from company pages; Ashirvad, Buhler (India), a Faurecia seating plant and Essae-Teraoka are OSM-mapped. Heritage Foods' Yadavanahalli dairy lies just north of it.

techParks.name: Aurbis Business Park
techParks.description: Office building on the Outer Ring Road beside Embassy TechVillage; OSM pins a PhonePe office inside it (unconfirmed).

techParks.name: Bagmane Capital
techParks.description: Bagmane's largest ORR campus (launched 2017, 42 acres, 10.5 msf planned) east of Constellation at Doddanekundi Circle, with towers named for world cities: Luxor South and North (GSK's GCC, IBM/Apptio, EPAM, Encora, HCLTech, FAB), Kyoto West and East (Google's 8.7 lakh sq ft 'Kyoto Campus'), Rome South and North (Amazon, American Express), Angkor East and West (Qualcomm, Wayfair, Samsung Semiconductor India Research), Apollo, Troy (Synopsys) and the under-construction Memphis towers. Bagmane also lists Microsoft, BNP Paribas, Databricks and Arm; the Luxor campus (~1 msf) is being folded into the Bagmane REIT.

techParks.name: Bagmane Constellation Business Park
techParks.description: A 30-acre, 5.3 msf campus (2007) at Ferns City, Doddanekundi, on the Outer Ring Road south of Bagmane WTC, with towers named for constellations: Phoenix (Samsung R&D Institute India-Bangalore, #2870), Virgo (Qualcomm's 2.56 lakh sq ft 2025 lease), Carina East and West (Google, Red Hat), Orion, Aquila and Taurus 1-4 (Amazon's BLR14 and sister buildings; Arm's new 409,450 sq ft Taurus-4 North Tower). Bagmane also lists Boeing and Nvidia as occupiers.

techParks.name: Bagmane Cosmos
techParks.description: Bagmane's newest C.V. Raman Nagar campus (launched 2022, under development) immediately east of Bagmane Tech Park: five planned blocks of which Ariel (550,000 sq ft, Texas Instruments), Vesta (496,800 sq ft, Lam Research and Palo Alto Networks) and Ceres (550,000 sq ft) are named, 3.5 msf in all. It is the Bagmane REIT's growth asset in this cluster.

techParks.name: Bagmane Rio Business Park
techParks.locality: Mahadevapura, Outer Ring Road (west of Bagmane WTC)
techParks.description: Bagmane's built-to-suit park beside the WTC campus; OpenStreetMap names its main building 'Google Ananta', the 1.6 msf, 5,000-seat campus Google inaugurated in February 2025 as its largest in India. The Bagmane REIT records Rio as a 1.1 msf asset (93% stake being acquired), so the 1.6 msf press figure likely includes space beyond the REIT's leasable area.

techParks.name: Bagmane Solarium City
techParks.description: An 82-acre campus (launched 2017, 10.5 msf planned) on ITPL Main Road at the cusp of the Outer Ring Road and Whitefield, between Doddanekundi and Kundalahalli, with blocks named for noble gases - Neon, Xenon North and South, Argon, Helium, Radon - plus numbered buildings on the ITPL Main Road side. Occupiers include Cognizant, Carelon Global Solutions (Xenon South), Shell Business Operations, Schneider Electric's 0.48 msf R&D centre, Tekion, Northern Trust, Baker Hughes, Zebra Technologies, Omnicom/DDB and Visteon, with OSM also recording AMD, IBM, SAP Fioneer, Thermo Fisher, Harman, o9 and Netskope.

techParks.name: Bagmane Tech Park
aliases: Bagmane Tech Park CV Raman Nagar
techParks.description: Bagmane Group's first and flagship campus (launched 2001) on 42 acres at Byrasandra, C.V. Raman Nagar, bordering HAL and DRDO land east of the old HAL airport: about ten buildings - Olympia, Lakeview, Tridib, Laurel, Parin, Quay, Commerz, Crown and a dedicated Cognizant building - totalling 4.7 msf, with Bagmane's own head office on the 5th floor of Laurel Block B. The new 3.5 msf Bagmane Cosmos (Ariel, Vesta, Ceres) rises on its eastern edge. Anchors are Texas Instruments' India HQ (Lakeview), Dell's R&D centre, Volvo Group India's head office (Tridib), Cognizant, PwC's Acceleration Center and Palo Alto Networks (Quay), Motorola Solutions and Nike (Olympia), Infineon and OpenText/Micro Focus (Laurel), Grant Thornton (Tridib) and Lam Research.

techParks.name: Bagmane World Technology Center
techParks.description: A 28-acre SEZ campus (2007) on the K.R. Puram-Marathahalli stretch of the Outer Ring Road at Mahadevapura, 4.5 msf across gem-named blocks: Aquamarine (Visa, Ericsson, Mphasis' corporate HQ), Citrine (Ericsson, Arm, Microland), Peridot (Accenture, AB InBev GCC), Amber (Boeing, Extreme Networks), Moonstone / the Dell EMC towers, Coral (EY GDS), the 993,000 sq ft Goldstone tower (Samsung R&D, Nvidia) and Opal (Google). Google's Bagmane Rio campus adjoins it to the west and Bagmane Constellation to the south.

techParks.name: Barton Centre
techParks.description: Older mixed-use office block at 84 MG Road; mainly small professional firms, no large anchor tenant could be verified.

techParks.name: BEL Bengaluru Complex (Jalahalli)
techParks.description: BEL's founding (1954) factory campus at Jalahalli, holding the Bangalore unit, Central Research Laboratory, Product Development & Innovation Centre, BEL Academy for Excellence, the BEL-Thales Systems joint venture and DRDO's MTRDC. Point is Nominatim's 'Bharat Electronics Limited' feature; no named polygon in the OSM extract.

techParks.name: Bengaluru Aerospace Park
aliases: Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park - Aerospace Sector
techParks.description: The aerospace sector of KIADB's Hi-Tech, Defence and Aerospace Park beside Kempegowda International Airport, on SH-104 east of the airfield. Brigade and Deccan Herald describe a roughly 1,000-acre industrial park (later quoted at ~2,000 acres with expansion) with about 250 acres notified as an aerospace SEZ. Starrag's 2013 plant was the first factory to start here; it now holds Boeing's 43-acre BIETC campus, Collins Aerospace's 26-acre India Operations Center, the Safran-HAL engine-parts JV, Dynamatic Aerotropolis and a cluster of Indian and foreign aerostructure, avionics and space suppliers. A 1,777-acre expansion across 13 villages was dropped by the state in July 2025 after farmer protests.

techParks.name: Bengaluru Airport City Business Park
techParks.description: A 2 million sq ft, four-block business park on 17.7 acres inside the airport campus, targeting global capability centres. Bengaluru Airport City Ltd, a BIAL subsidiary, broke ground in Oct 2024 and projected first occupancy in 2026; no tenants named yet.

techParks.name: Bengaluru Lifesciences Research District
techParks.locality: Bhaktipura village, Attibele Hobli, Anekal Taluk 562106
techParks.description: A 50-acre life-sciences research district at Survey Nos. 41-44/4, Bhaktipura Village, Attibele Hobli, marketed for the Attibele-Jigani-Bommasandra pharma cluster; its site names no tenants or developer (leasing contacts use an rxpropellant.com address) and does not say whether it is built, so treat it as a development rather than an operating park. OSM maps it as way/1163804912.

techParks.name: Bengaluru Signature Business Park
techParks.description: A 407-acre KSIIDC business district planned next to Kempegowda airport (business, MICE, design-and-culture and innovation districts plus the Bengaluru International Convention Centre). Foundation stone laid Feb 2018 after a decade in abeyance; in May 2026 the cabinet cleared 140 acres for Applied Materials, with 267 acres left to allot.

techParks.name: Bharat IT Park
techParks.description: Small office campus on Sarjapur Main Road at Ambalipura (Haralur side), between Bellandur Gate and Kaikondrahalli; OSM names it 'Zepto HQ-Bharat IT Park'. Developer and size unknown. Polygon from OSM way/1389761625.

techParks.name: Bhartiya Centre of Information Technology
techParks.locality: Thanisandra Main Road (Bhartiya City, north Bengaluru)
techParks.description: The office component of Bhartiya City, Bhartiya Urban's 125-acre township on Thanisandra Main Road: blocks BCIT 1, 2, 3A and 3B are complete and occupied, with The Leela hotel alongside. The developer's page quotes 4.1 million sq ft of workspace in one place and 'over 2 million' in another (the latter likely the built phase). Tenant names come from the developer's logo wall, with OSM POIs confirming most of the larger occupiers. The brief's Sony, Micron, Lowe's, Shell and Ericsson guesses are not on the developer's list.

techParks.name: Bhoruka Tech Park
aliases: Bhoruka Tech Park, Mahadevapura Industrial Area
techParks.description: Older industrial-estate office campus on Whitefield Road at Garudachar Palya/Hoodi, next to Brigade Metropolis; Tata Elxsi's own contact page lists Block I here, and OSM maps an ABB block and a Hitachi Energy office on the same plot.

techParks.name: Bidadi Industrial Area
techParks.locality: Bidadi, Ramanagara (Bengaluru South district), Bengaluru-Mysuru highway
techParks.description: A roughly 1,500-acre KIADB manufacturing estate about 30 km south-west of Bengaluru on the Mysuru highway, anchored since 1997-98 by Toyota Kirloskar Motor and its group companies, which hold about 60% of the land and most of its exports; the Bidadi Industries Association counted 114-140 member units in 2016, mostly auto-component and food manufacturers, with Bosch, Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages and Britannia the other large names. A third Toyota plant was approved in 2024. OSM maps the core estate polygon; Coca-Cola's plant sits in the Phase 2 extension to the north near Hejjala.

techParks.name: Biocon Park
techParks.description: Biocon's research and biologics-manufacturing campus and SEZ on the Bommasandra-Jigani link road; Wikipedia pictures the Biocon Research Centre inside it, and Syngene International is headquartered here. Mapped in OpenStreetMap as way/545039647 with a 'Biocon' building inside (way/279472179).

techParks.name: Boeing India Engineering and Technology Center
techParks.description: Boeing's 43-acre, Rs 1,600 crore engineering and technology campus inside the Bengaluru Aerospace Park, its largest investment outside the US. PM Modi inaugurated it on 19 Jan 2024 and Building 2 opened in Aug 2024.

techParks.name: Bommasandra Industrial Area
techParks.locality: Bommasandra / Hebbagodi, Hosur Road, Anekal Taluk 560099
techParks.description: KIADB's manufacturing estate on Hosur Road immediately south of Electronic City (OSM way/103293015, operator KIADB). Its plots run from Hebbagodi down Hosur Road to Narayana Health City and west along the Bommasandra-Jigani link road (Phase IV), where Biocon Park, Apotex, Atotech and TaeguTec sit; company addresses on that road read 'Bommasandra Industrial Area' even several kilometres from the core polygon. Tenants confirmed from company pages here include Mersen (No. 5 and No. 19), Anthem Biosciences (No. 49 Canara Bank Road), Sansera Engineering (several plants), Micro Labs (three Bommasandra sites), OneSource (#293 Jigani Link Road) and Narayana Health City (258/A); SKF, Delta, Syngene and a Siemens Healthineers construction site are OSM-mapped.

techParks.name: Bosch Adugodi Campus
techParks.description: Bosch Limited's historic Hosur Road headquarters site at Adugodi, redeveloped as the Spark.NXT smart campus housing the Indian headquarters and R&D functions; the LEI registered office for Bosch Limited is 'Hosur Road, Adugodi, Bangalore 560030'.

techParks.name: Bosch Global Software Technologies Koramangala Campus
techParks.description: Bosch Global Software Technologies' (formerly RBEI) headquarters campus at No. 123 Industrial Layout, Hosur Road, opposite the Forum Mall side road; OSM maps it as 'Bosch RBEI' with buildings 901, 903 and 905.

techParks.name: Bren Optimus
techParks.locality: Dairy Circle, Dr M H Marigowda Road (Bannerghatta Road start)
techParks.description: Bren Corporation office block at No 8/2 Dr M H Marigowda Road 560029, next to Prestige Blue Chip and Prestige Technopolis at the Bannerghatta-Hosur Road junction; Brillio's Bengaluru office is on its 4th floor.

techParks.name: Brigade Magnum
techParks.description: Brigade's Grade-A office block on Bellary Road just north of the Hebbal flyover, next to RMZ Latitude and Brigade Opus. Tenants are OSM POIs only (Citi, PwC, Gallagher, ABB); Brigade's commercial listing page no longer features the project, so nothing was verified from the developer.

techParks.name: Brigade Metropolis
techParks.locality: Garudachar Palya, Mahadevapura (Whitefield Road / ITPL Main Road)
techParks.description: Brigade's 40-acre integrated township on Whitefield Road; its office component is Summit (Towers A/B, the B-9 building on ITPL Main Road) plus The Arcade retail-and-small-office block. Awfis runs a coworking centre there and Kapture CX is headquartered on the 11th floor; Capgemini, Volvo and EY offices are mapped on the Summit towers.

techParks.name: Brigade Opus
techParks.description: Brigade office building at 70/401 Kodigehalli Main Road off Bellary Road, Hebbal; Hitachi Energy India's registered office (8th floor) per its filings. OSM places the Hitachi Energy POI and a cluster of other offices (Epson, Accenture, Berkadia, Netsmart, TerraPay, Westermo, Gallagher, ReSource Pro, Awfis) about 300 m north in a block it names 'Godrej Downtown'; that name could not be verified and those tenants are recorded against the block rather than this building.

techParks.name: Brigade Rubix
techParks.description: Brigade Group's 2-basement + ground + 11-floor office building on HMT Link Road near the HMT township, with 14,000 sq ft typical floor plates, marketed to firms wanting to be near Wipro and ABB in Peenya; tenants not published.

techParks.name: Brigade Senate
techParks.description: Brigade's office development at Hebbal-Kempapura on the Hebbal flyover side of Bellary Road; Digantara's India HQ is on the 9th floor of Brigade Senate 2. Coordinates and bbox are the OSM polygon.

techParks.name: Brigade Software Park
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: Brigade Tech Gardens
techParks.description: A ~3 million sq ft LEED Platinum SEZ campus on Brookefields Green Avenue, Kundalahalli (ITPL Main Road, Phase 2), developed by Brigade Enterprises with GIC and inaugurated in December 2022; six blocks in a B cluster (B1, B3) and a C cluster (C1, C2, C4, C5), with BuzzWorks coworking. Confirmed occupiers include Manhattan Associates (B1, since 2019), Aptiv's Technical Center India (237,000 sq ft, Feb 2023), JLR's technology and business services arm (~2.04 lakh sq ft) and FNF India (Butterfly building, B1).

techParks.name: Brigade Twin Towers
techParks.description: Twin office towers by Brigade on the Tumkur Road / Outer Ring Road junction at Goraguntepalya, opposite the under-construction RNS Business Park; mapped in OSM (way 133883061). No tenant list was found.

techParks.name: Cessna Business Park
techParks.description: A 22-acre, roughly 4.5 million sq ft IT SEZ campus of 11 towers on the Outer Ring Road at Kadubeesanahalli, developed by Prestige Estates and now managed by Nucleus Office Parks. Cisco's Bengaluru campus (its Globalisation Centre East, buildings BGL 11-18 in OSM) takes up most of the SEZ; Walmart Global Tech, Micron and Sapiens occupy the numbered SEZ buildings 10-11, and the Aloft hotel and the three-block Prestige Tech Pacific Park sit inside the precinct. Property sites also name HCL, Cargill, Sixt R&D, Zensar and Xavient; only those with corroboration are listed.

techParks.name: Diamond District
techParks.description: A late-1990s mixed-use estate on HAL Old Airport Road at Kodihalli: residential towers around a commercial block (Towers A-D) that has long housed startups and tech offices. OSM records Gojek's India engineering centre, Zeta, the NASSCOM 10,000 Startups warehouse (Tower D) and a BHive coworking centre here; Zoomcar's registered office was Tower B, 7th floor before it moved to Anjaneya Techno Park next door, and apna was recorded here before listing an Ejipura address. OSM tags the operator as IBC Group, which could not be verified.

techParks.name: Divyasree 77 Town Centre
techParks.description: DivyaSree's mixed-use office campus at Yemalur between the Outer Ring Road and the airport road; OpenStreetMap records Deloitte and Thomson Reuters offices inside it (unconfirmed elsewhere).

techParks.name: Divyasree Greens
techParks.description: A mid-size office campus on the Intermediate Ring Road immediately west of Embassy GolfLinks, on survey numbers 12/1, 12/2A and 13/1A of Challaghatta village. Atlassian's own contact page places its Bengaluru office on the 4th and 5th floors; OSM also records a Dell India office in the compound.

techParks.name: DivyaSree Technopark
techParks.description: DivyaSree's IT/ITES SEZ at Sy. No. 36/2, Kundalahalli (Doddanakundi post), at the southern edge of the EPIP zone next to the Huawei campus. Wipro (SEZ Units I & II), Capgemini (blocks B4, B5, A5, A6) and Accenture list offices here. Distinct from DivyaSree Technopolis on the Old Airport Road / Yemalur side.

techParks.name: Divyasree Technopolis
techParks.description: DivyaSree's IT park at 124/125 Yemalur Main Road off Old Airport Road, east of HAL Airport, with the newer DivyaSree 77 East / 77 Town Centre blocks beside it. CGI's offices page confirms its Bengaluru centre here; OSM records Thomson Reuters and Deloitte. Centroid is derived from the OSM tenant POIs because the park polygon is not drawn in OSM. Walmart Global Tech, Microsoft, Myntra, Sapient, Hitachi and Mu Sigma, suggested by the lens prompt, could not be confirmed as tenants.

techParks.name: DivyaSree Towers
techParks.description: DivyaSree office building at 55 Bannerghatta Main Road; OSM shows Convergys (now Concentrix), CSG, WinWire and V2Soft nodes around it and Cleartrip and Valtech just south, none confirmed from a company source, so no tenants are asserted.

techParks.name: DRDO Complex, C V Raman Nagar
aliases: DRDO Phase 1, C V Raman Nagar
DRDO Township C V Raman Nagar
techParks.description: DRDO's Bengaluru campus at C V Raman Nagar housing LRDE (radars), CAIR (AI and robotics), CASDIC (ex-DARE avionics) and GTRE (aero-engines), with HAL's Engine Division and IMGT Division next door. Centroid averaged from the LRDE, CAIR and GTRE OSM polygons.

techParks.name: Eastland Citadel
techParks.description: Commercial building at 102 Hosur Road near the Madiwala check post and the Forum Mall cluster; Jumbotail's headquarters (6th floor).

techParks.name: Ebisu Tech Park
techParks.locality: Nagavara (Hebbal Outer Ring Road, beside Manyata south gate)
techParks.description: Under construction per OSM, between the Manpho Convention Centre and the Manyata NXT towers on the Nagavara side of the ORR; no tenants yet.

techParks.name: Electronics City Phase 1
techParks.locality: Electronic City (west of Hosur Road), Bengaluru 560100
techParks.description: The original KEONICS township (founded 1978 by R. K. Baliga; about 800 acres across all phases, roughly 200 IT/ITES campuses, maintained since 1997 by the Electronics City Industrial Township Authority, ELCITA). Phase 1 is the older, mostly west-of-Hosur-Road core holding the Infosys and Wipro headquarters campuses, the Siemens/3M/BHEL/HP strip along Hosur Road, the E-City towers at Veerasandra and the C-DOT, C-DAC and STPI government campuses. Coordinates and bbox are derived from the cluster of Phase 1 features in OpenStreetMap, not from an official boundary.
notableTenants: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing

techParks.name: Electronics City Phase 2
aliases: KIADB Industrial Area Phase II Electronic City
techParks.locality: Electronic City (east of Hosur Road) / Doddathogur / Veerasandra, Bengaluru 560100
techParks.description: The KIADB-developed eastern extension of Electronics City (the 'KIADB Industrial Area, Phase II, Electronic City' of company addresses), reached from Hosur Road via Shantipura Main Road and Infosys Avenue. It holds the TCS Think Campus, Tech Mahindra's plots 45-47, Continental's Technical Center India, Aurigene (plots 39-40), Hical (plots 46-47), the Gold Hill parks and the Veerasandra Industrial Estate with Titan's 'Integrity' office and Tessolve. Coordinates and bbox are derived from the cluster of Phase 2 features in OpenStreetMap.

techParks.name: Embassy Business Hub
techParks.developer: Embassy Group / Embassy Office Parks REIT
techParks.description: Embassy REIT's 59-acre campus-style business park on Bellary Road in North Bengaluru, about 20 minutes from the airport: 1.4 million sq ft leasable, of which 0.4 msf is complete and 100% committed to a single occupier and 1.0 msf is in early development. OSM maps the completed parcel as 'Embassy Business Hub - Philips' with a Philips Innovation Campus POI; the REIT page does not name the occupier.

techParks.name: Embassy Crest
techParks.description: Embassy's two-phase office building in EPIP Phase 1 next to Whitefield Palms. Mercedes-Benz R&D India renewed its lease here for 60 months at the end of 2023.

techParks.name: Embassy GolfLinks Business Park
techParks.locality: Challaghatta / Domlur, Koramangala-Indiranagar Intermediate Ring Road
techParks.description: A 37.11-acre low-rise campus beside the Karnataka Golf Association course at Challaghatta, off the Intermediate Ring Road between Domlur and Koramangala. Its blocks are named after golf courses (Augusta, Cherry Hills, Cinnabar Hills, Crystal Downs, Cypress Point, Pacific Dunes, Pebble Beach, Pine Valley, Pinehurst, St. Andrews / Signature, Sunningdale, Sunriver, Torrey Pines) and OSM records them individually. Embassy REIT reports 3.4 msf of leasable area (3.1 msf completed), 100% occupancy and 30 occupiers; a Hilton hotel sits inside the park. WeWork runs centres in Cherry Hills, Sunriver and GolfLinks blocks. Yahoo (R&D closed 2014) and Microsoft (now at Ferns Galaxy, Vigyan and Bagmane Capital per its own page) were historic occupiers and are not listed as current tenants.

techParks.name: Embassy Icon
techParks.description: Embassy office building on Infantry Road beside Embassy Point; no tenant verified in this run.

techParks.name: Embassy One
techParks.description: Mixed-use tower complex on Bellary Road at the start of the airport road, with the Four Seasons hotel, residences and the Pinnacle office tower that houses Embassy REIT's own principal office and Illumina India.

techParks.name: Embassy Point
techParks.description: Embassy Group's original corporate-office building at 150 Infantry Road (the group has since moved its HQ to Pinnacle Tower, Hebbal).

techParks.name: Embassy Quest
techParks.description: Embassy office building on Magrath Road operated as a WeWork centre.

techParks.name: Embassy Square
techParks.description: Embassy Group office building at 148 Infantry Road beside Embassy Point and Embassy Icon; no tenant could be verified in this run.

techParks.name: Embassy Tech Square
techParks.description: Embassy Group's ~8-acre, 2.2 million sq ft non-SEZ office park at Kaverappa Layout, Kadubeesanahalli, on the inner side of the ORR between Cessna Business Park and Embassy TechVillage. Its four blocks are Omega, Alpha, Delta and Signet, so 'Embassy Signet' is a block here rather than a separate park. InMobi's headquarters is on the 7th floor of Delta; LG Soft India has its own building. A 2011-vintage listing also named Xiaomi India in Delta, but Xiaomi has since consolidated at Embassy TechVillage so it is not recorded as a current tenant. Coordinates are the mean of the Omega, InMobi and LG Soft OSM features; no park polygon exists in OSM.

techParks.name: Embassy TechVillage
techParks.description: Integrated SEZ/non-SEZ office park on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli Outer Ring Road at Devarabeesanahalli (Bellandur), begun in 2008 as Vrindavan Tech Village and renamed after Embassy Office Parks bought the controlling stake in May 2014 (INR 1,951 crore, 106 acres). Embassy REIT acquired it for about INR 97.8 billion (USD 1.3 billion) in December 2020. REIT disclosures give an 84.05-acre site (the 2018 and 2023 press releases say 103 acres), 9.2 msf leasable (6.1 msf completed, 3.1 msf development as of FY21), 97-98% occupancy and 40+ occupiers employing 45,000+ people. Blocks are named after flowers and plants: Hibiscus (Block 2B, Towers 1-3), Gardenia (2D), Iris (3A), Primrose (7B), Trillium (Blocks I & J), Alyssa/Begonia/Clover (Flipkart's three linked towers), plus numbered blocks 1, 2A-2D, 3A-3B, 5A-5L, 7, 8A-8D, 9A-9C and Block L (WeWork). Parcel 9 is JPMorgan Chase's 1.1 msf built-to-suit corporate centre (opened August 2023); Parcel 8 is a 1.9 msf mixed-use parcel with four office towers and a 518-key dual-branded Hilton / Hilton Garden Inn, facing the ORR and a proposed Metro station. IGBC Platinum green campus (2017) and LEED Platinum O+M.

techParks.name: EPIP Zone Whitefield
techParks.description: The KIADB Export Promotion Industrial Park in Whitefield, laid out in Phase I (around Whitefield Main Road / Hoodi) and Phase II (towards Brookefield and Kundalahalli), is a plotted industrial-cum-IT zone rather than a single campus. It hosts owner-occupied R&D campuses (SAP Labs India #138, GE's John F. Welch Technology Centre at #122, Tesco #81-82, Qualcomm #125-127, AMD #102-103, Microchip #149-B, NTT DATA #178, Capgemini #155-170, TCS Abhilash #96 and L-Centre #78-83) plus multi-tenant buildings such as Gopalan Global Axis (#152), Kalyani Platina (#6 & 24), Mindcomp Tech Park (#149-A), Whitefield Palms and Embassy Crest. The coordinate is the Photon/OSM node for 'EPIP Zone', not a polygon centroid.

techParks.name: Fairway Business Park
techParks.description: Office building behind Dell at Challaghatta, Domlur; BigBasket's operating company (Supermarket Grocery Supplies) is registered on its 2nd, 7th and 8th floors.

techParks.name: Global Technology Park
techParks.description: Mapletree's 12-acre, LEED Gold business park of about 1.9 million sq ft in Towers A-E (Phase 1 Towers A and B of ~480,000 sq ft each, Phase 2 Towers C, D and E), the original tenant being LSI Logic in 2011. Property listings name Arista Networks, Vodafone Global Services/_VOIS, LinkedIn, GSN Games, SoftwareONE and Tangoe as occupiers; Marvell's own site gives Towers D and E. Mapletree has been reported to be marketing the park for sale with bids from Embassy, Actis and GIC.

techParks.name: Global Village Tech Park
techParks.locality: Pattanagere / Mylasandra, Rajarajeshwari Nagar - Kengeri, off Mysore Road (behind RV College of Engineering)
techParks.developer: Tanglin Developments (Coffee Day Group); owned since 2019 by Blackstone (80%) and Sattva Group (20%)
techParks.description: A 120-acre IT/ITES SEZ-plus-non-SEZ campus off Mysore Road beside Pattanagere metro station, built from 2005 by Cafe Coffee Day's realty arm Tanglin Developments and sold in September 2019 for about Rs 2,700 crore to a Blackstone (80%) / Salarpuria Sattva (20%) consortium, which renamed it Sattva Global City. Wikipedia and the sale reports give ~3.3 million sq ft built up across Towers A-F, Mindtree's Phases 1-5, the DRC and Ivega buildings and production blocks PB2-PB4 (the 'Texas Block' recalls an earlier Texas Instruments tenancy); Sattva's own page quotes 78.3 acres, 12.1 M sq ft leasable and 81.2% committed occupancy as of March 2025, figures that do not reconcile with the others and are flagged rather than adopted. OSM maps it as 'Sattva Global City'.

techParks.name: Godrej Centre
techParks.description: Commercial building ('Tower 1') on Kodigehalli Main Road at Bellary Road, 400 m north of Brigade Opus, that OSM names 'Godrej Downtown'; the name and developer could not be corroborated with the search budget exhausted, so treat the park name as provisional. OSM records ten office tenants here, including Hitachi Energy India's headquarters.

techParks.name: Gold Hill Excelsior Park
techParks.description: Gold Hill's software park in Electronics City Phase 2 beside TCS Think Campus and Tech Mahindra (North Wing / South Wing buildings in OSM); a Siemens node sits inside it in OpenStreetMap. Gold Hill Supreme Park lies just south on Infosys Avenue.

techParks.name: Golden Tower
techParks.locality: Rupena Agrahara, Bommanahalli, Hosur Main Road
techParks.description: Office building on Hosur Main Road at Rupena Agrahara, Bommanahalli 560068; emids' India office.

techParks.name: Gopalan Global Axis
techParks.locality: EPIP Zone Phase 2, Hoodi Village, Whitefield
techParks.description: Gopalan Enterprises' IT SEZ at Plot 152, EPIP Zone (Hoodi village, K.R. Puram Hobli), on ITPL Main Road; Square Yards gives the project as 26 acres. Oracle Financial Services Software (Units I & II), LTIMindtree (4th-7th floors) and Unisys Global Services India (Block G, 3rd-4th floors) list it as an office, and GoodWorks runs a ~42,000 sq ft managed office here.

techParks.name: GR Tech Park
techParks.description: Office park east of ITPB at Pattandur Agrahara (blocks include Vayu), where Awfis runs a coworking centre on the first floor of Vayu block. OSM maps SAP, HP, Sapient and TCS (Jal, Dhara, Agni) POIs inside it, but no current tenant could be confirmed from a primary source.

techParks.name: HAL Bangalore Complex
techParks.description: The government aerospace cluster around HAL Airport: HAL's Bangalore Complex (Aircraft, Overhaul, Foundry & Forge, Aerospace, LCA Tejas divisions), Helicopter Complex and Design Complex line HAL Old Airport Road from Vimanapura to Marathahalli, with URSC, NAL Kodihalli and ADA on the same road. Centroid is the Vimanapura locality; bbox is the union of the mapped HAL/URSC/NAL/ARDC polygons.

techParks.name: HCL Technologies SEZ Jigani
techParks.description: HCLTech's SEZ delivery campus off the Bommasandra-Jigani link road (OSM way/170320607), with an 'HCL Autonomous Car Test Area' mapped inside it; Aragen's biologics plant adjoins it to the west. Wikipedia's Jigani article names HCL among the companies that brought workers to the area.

techParks.name: Helios Business Park
aliases: Helios Business Park, 150 Outer Ring Road
techParks.description: A LEED Platinum office campus at No. 150 Outer Ring Road, Kadubeesanahalli, immediately west of Prestige Tech Park IV and north of Salarpuria Touchstone. The Executive Centre's listing for its Towers C, D and E names Goldman Sachs and the Volkswagen Group as fellow occupiers; OSM places Meesho (Wing E) and MakeMyTrip inside the park. Goldman Sachs' owned Bengaluru campus is widely reported here but its own locations page could not be fetched, so the developer and size are left null.

techParks.name: HGS House
techParks.description: Hinduja Global Solutions' own building on Hosur Road at Vajpayee Nagar, Bommanahalli, recorded by OSM; HGS's registered office.

techParks.name: Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park - IT Sector
aliases: Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park (IT Sector)
techParks.description: The IT sector of KIADB's Hi-Tech, Defence and Aerospace Park, mapped in OSM as 'Bengaluru IT Park' (KIADB) between the Hardware Park and the aerospace sector. Company addresses here carry the form 'Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park (IT Sector)'. Tenants include SAP Labs India's 41-acre Innovation Park (Aug 2025), the eMudhra Digital Campus and Autoliv India's safety centre and plant; CDC's Technology Innovation International Park and Jayalakshmi Tech Park are under construction alongside.

techParks.name: Hinduja Ecopolis
techParks.description: Hinduja Realty's office development on Bellary Road at Kogilu, north of Yelahanka, mapped as commercial in OSM (way/1079506848); no tenant could be identified.

techParks.name: Hindustan Unilever Research Centre
techParks.description: Unilever's own R&D campus at 64 Main Road, Whitefield, a global Unilever R&D hub since 2006 developing home-care, personal-care and nutrition formulations.

techParks.name: HM Tech Park
techParks.description: Office building on Whitefield Main Road near Hope Farm, Kadugodi; Netradyne's Bengaluru engineering office is based here per its job postings.

techParks.name: Honeywell Technology Solutions Lab Campus
techParks.description: Single-tenant campus of Honeywell Technology Solutions Lab at No. 151/1 Doraisanipalya, Bannerghatta Road 560076, the original home of Honeywell's India engineering arm. Honeywell's current locations page lists only its two Bellandur campuses, so whether this site is still occupied is unconfirmed.

techParks.name: Hoskote Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB industrial area east of the city on the Chennai highway; site of Volvo's Indian truck and bus plant.

techParks.name: Huawei India R&D Campus
techParks.description: Huawei's own R&D campus in Whitefield, the successor to the telecom-software R&D centre it opened in Bengaluru in 1999.

techParks.name: HustleHub Tech Park
techParks.description: Managed office campus at 36/5 Somasundarapalya, 27th Main Road, HSR Layout Sector 2; all three Acko insurance companies are registered in HustleHub One East. Not mapped as a polygon; the point is a tenant POI carrying the campus address.

techParks.name: IBC Knowledge Park
techParks.locality: Bannerghatta Road, S.G. Palya (near Dairy Circle)
techParks.description: Multi-tower IT park at 4/1 Bannerghatta Main Road built around 2004, the corridor's anchor office campus: Accenture's Bannerghatta delivery centre, ACL Digital (Tower D), Ather Energy's corporate office and Byju's shrinking headquarters are here, and Swiggy ran its HQ from Tower D until it moved to Embassy TechVillage. Oracle's own Oracle Technology Park adjoins it to the north. Developer and total area were not confirmed.

techParks.name: Iggalur Industrial Area
techParks.description: Small KIADB industrial area south of Chandapura (OSM way/1119637971, tagged industrial=factory); no tenant could be confirmed during this run, so the tenant list is empty.

techParks.name: IndiQube Golf View Homes
aliases: Golf View Homes Wind Tunnel Road
techParks.description: A cluster of three office towers plus an IndiQube managed-office centre on NAL Wind Tunnel Road at Murugeshpalya, behind the HAL Old Airport Road frontage. Enphase Energy's India office is at IndiQube Golf View Homes per its own contact page; OSM also records nference, Ipsos, DDB Mudra, ansrsource and (historically) Omega Healthcare here.

techParks.name: IndiQube Grandeur
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: IndiQube Grape Garden (coworking)
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: IndiQube Logos
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: IndiQube Penta
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: IndiQube Sapphire
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: IndiQube Sigma
techParks.description: Named as a tenant location by the research; the park itself has not been described or verified yet.

techParks.name: IndiQube Symphony
techParks.description: Managed-office building at 25 MG Road operated by IndiQube; Khaitan & Co occupies three floors of Tower 2.

techParks.name: IndoSpace Logistics Complex Bommasandra
techParks.locality: Masthanahalli Road, Rajapura, Bommasandra-Jigani Link Road 560099
techParks.description: Warehousing and logistics park off the Bommasandra-Jigani link road, mapped in OSM as way/1335879047; tenants were not confirmed.

techParks.name: Infosys Electronics City Campus
techParks.description: Infosys's ~80-acre owned global headquarters campus on Hosur Road (No. 44, Infosys Avenue), the company's registered office and largest single site. Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: Intel India SRR Campus
aliases: Intel India Sarjapur Ring Road campus
techParks.locality: Devarabeesanahalli, Bellandur (Outer Ring Road, opposite Global Technology Park)
techParks.description: Intel's own 44-acre campus on the Outer Ring Road at Devarabeesanahalli, its largest design and engineering site outside the United States, with buildings SRR1-SRR5; the 620,000 sq ft SRR4 design house opened in 2022 after an announced Rs 1,100 crore expansion. Owner-occupied, so not a multi-tenant park, but it is the single largest employer site on this stretch other than Ecoworld. Centroid from the OSM landuse polygon named 'Intel'.

techParks.name: International Tech Park Bangalore
techParks.description: Bengaluru's oldest tech park, begun in January 1994 as an India-Singapore joint venture (Singapore consortium led by Ascendas 47%, Tata Group 47%, KIADB 6%) and now owned and managed by CapitaLand India Trust, for which it is the largest asset at 6.1 million sq ft of floor area (30 June 2026) on a 69-acre integrated site about 18 km east of the centre, with 92% committed occupancy including the newly completed MTB 6. Blocks: Discoverer, Innovator, Creator (2000), Explorer, Inventor, Navigator (1998), Pioneer (TCS's own), Voyager (Jun 2011, 0.5 msf), Aviator (Jan 2014, 0.6 msf), Victor (Jun 2016, 0.6 msf), Anchor (May 2019, 0.5 msf, SEZ), Anchor Annex (Nov 2020, 0.7 msf), Endeavour / MTB 6 (Jan 2025, 0.8 msf, fully leased to Applied Materials), a smaller MTB 4, and Tower 8 planned for late 2027; the park also holds the 450,000 sq ft Park Square mall (2010), a Vivanta by Taj hotel, a CapitaLand data centre and a Bridge+ flex-work centre. Part of the campus is a notified SEZ (the Aviator/Voyager/Victor/Anchor cluster). The OSM landuse polygon used for the bbox covers the core blocks and may not span the full 69 acres.

techParks.name: ISRO HQ Campus (Antariksh Bhavan)
techParks.description: The Department of Space / ISRO headquarters campus (Antariksh Bhavan) on New BEL Road, which also houses the Human Space Flight Centre, NSIL's registered office and Antrix. Polygon is OSM way/42396273.

techParks.name: ITC Infotech Park
techParks.description: ITC's own corporate campus at 18 Banaswadi Main Road, north of Ulsoor, housing ITC Infotech's global headquarters alongside the LEED-platinum ITC Green Centre. Confirmed by ITC Infotech's contact page; OSM polygon 'ITC'.

techParks.name: Jigani Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB estate at Jigani, south-west of Bommasandra (OSM way/103293010), mixing granite exporters, food and packaging units and small engineering shops with Otis India's plot-92 elevator factory, LAPP India's cable plant, Sansera's Plants 9 and 14 and the Tata composites works where TASL opened an Airbus composite-structures plant in November 2025. Wikipedia's Jigani article also names HCL, APC and Toyota among the firms that brought workers here.

techParks.name: John F. Welch Technology Centre
aliases: GE John F. Welch Technology Centre
techParks.description: GE's first and largest integrated multidisciplinary R&D centre outside the US, inaugurated by Jack Welch on 17 September 2000 on a 50-acre campus in Whitefield's EPIP zone (plot 122). Since GE's 2024 split it is described as a GE Aerospace site (25th anniversary in 2025) while GE HealthCare still lists its X-ray division at No. 122 EPIP.

techParks.name: Kadugodi Industrial Area
techParks.description: Older KIADB industrial estate on Whitefield Main Road at Kadugodi / Sadaramangala, home to the Wipro GE Healthcare head office and medical-device factory at No. 4 (CT, cath-lab, ultrasound, patient monitoring).

techParks.name: Kalyani Magnum
techParks.locality: JP Nagar 7th Phase / Doraisanipalya, off Bannerghatta Road
techParks.description: Kalyani Developers' office campus (Blocks 1 and 2 with A/B wings) on the JP Nagar Ring Road beside Krishna Magnum and the Honeywell campus; OSM records Oracle India as the occupant, which could not be confirmed from Oracle or the developer.

techParks.name: Kalyani Platina
techParks.description: A multi-block office park (blocks include Block 1, Ebony and Magnolia) at Survey No 1, 6 & 24 of Kundalahalli village, EPIP Zone Phase 2, opposite Brookefield Hospital. An ICRA rationale (2016) reported 100% occupancy with the HP group taking 74% of the leased area; HP Inc, Infineon and GE HealthCare list addresses here. The coordinate is an OSM POI that carries the Kalyani Platina address, not a park polygon.

techParks.name: Karle Town Centre SEZ
techParks.description: Karle Infra's mixed-use SEZ on Kempe Gowda Main Road, Nagavara, just west of Manyata: office hubs (Hub 1, Hub 2, Hub 4 mapped in OSM, more under construction), the Manpho convention centre and residential towers. Tenants confirmed only from OSM: Epsilon (Hub 2), Vervent (Hub 1) and a Smartworks managed-office centre. The brief's guesses of Nokia, Goldman Sachs, Lowe's, Philips, Ericsson, Shell and Target were not borne out: Lowe's own site puts it at Manyata, Carelon (ex-Legato) now lists Manyata and Bagmane only, and OSM's Nokia/Target/Philips POIs all fall inside Manyata. Developer site returned 503.

techParks.name: Khanija Bhavan
techParks.description: State-owned office block at 49 Race Course Road housing Mysore Minerals, Trigent Software's HQ, an ABB research presence and the Bengaluru Arbitration Centre.

techParks.name: KIADB Hardware Park
aliases: Hi-Tech Defence and Aerospace Park - Hardware Sector
techParks.description: KIADB's electronics-hardware sector of the Hi-Tech, Defence and Aerospace Park, south-west of the airport between Bellary Road and Mahadeva Kodigehalli. Its anchor is Shell's 52-acre Technology Centre Bangalore; it also holds Cepheid's TB-cartridge plant (2023), Hengst Filtration, Zetwerk Electronics' defence/automotive electronics unit (Feb 2026) and smaller electronics, medical and drone makers.

techParks.name: Kirloskar Business Park
techParks.description: Mid-rise business park on Bellary Road beside the Hebbal flyover, developed on Kirloskar group land. OSM maps the park (way/265565391) and a Mahindra Comviva POI inside it; Comviva's current address list does not include it. The lens brief's guesses of Rolls-Royce, Dell, Siemens and Volvo here could not be substantiated: Rolls-Royce's own site places its Bengaluru centre at Manyata, and no source was reached for the others.

techParks.name: Kumbalgodu Industrial Area
techParks.locality: Kumbalgodu, Mysore Road, between Kengeri and Bidadi
techParks.description: A small industrial estate on the Bengaluru-Mysuru road at Kumbalgodu, west of Kengeri, mapped in OSM as 'Kumbalagodu Industrial Area'. No notable MNC, mid-size or startup tenant could be substantiated for it in this pass (no company page, press report or OSM office POI inside the polygon), so it is recorded for its footprint only.

techParks.name: L&T Tech Park
techParks.description: L&T Realty's SEZ campus on the 65-acre L&T land parcel on Bellary Road next to GKVK, housing LTTS (Tower S1) and LTIMindtree (Tower S2), with a second phase under construction. Coordinates and bbox from the OpenStreetMap landuse polygon in the research extract (osm-techparks.json).

techParks.name: Mantri Commercio
techParks.locality: Devarabeesanahalli, Bellandur (Outer Ring Road, near Sakra World Hospital)
techParks.description: A two-tower (A and B) mid-size office complex on the lake side of ORR at Devarabeesanahalli, best known as an early Flipkart office. Blue Yonder's own site gives Tower A as its Bangalore office; Rapido and a cluster of flexible-office operators (Innov8 on the 5th floor, 2gethr in Tower B, Spatium in Tower A) are the other substantiated occupiers. A broker page claims about 6,500 people work on the campus.

techParks.name: Manyata Tech Park
techParks.locality: Nagavara (Nagawara), Hebbal Outer Ring Road, north Bengaluru
techParks.description: Bengaluru's largest office park and the anchor of the city's northern corridor: about 300 acres at Nagavara on the Hebbal stretch of the Outer Ring Road, operational since 2001, with 12.8 msf completed and 3.1 msf under construction per Embassy Group (press coverage in 2026 puts leasable area near 17 msf across 25+ buildings) and 100,000+ workers from 60+ MNCs. Blocks carry both a letter code and a tree name: L1 Banyan, L2 Willow, L3 Hazel, H2 Mountain Ash, F2 Mahogany, E1 Beech, M2 Madhuvana, M3 (ANZ's built-to-suit), plus Redwood, Silver Oak, Silver Fir, Pine, Cedar, Balsa, Eucalyptus, Mulberry, Ebony, Teak, Poplar, Palm, Aspen, Cypress, Elm, Acacia and Green Heart, and the newer Manyata NXT towers beside the dual-branded Hilton hotels at the south gate. Greenheart Tech Park (~1.5 msf) is a strata-owned parcel inside the campus; MFAR developed another parcel. Anchor occupiers are IBM, Cognizant, Target and Oracle Health (Cerner), with Nokia (511k sq ft), ANZ (618k sq ft, Building M3), Target (831k sq ft from Sep 2025) and Commonwealth Bank of Australia (0.8-1.4 msf built-to-suit due late 2026) the largest recent leases.

techParks.name: Marksquare
techParks.description: Office building at 61 St Mark's Road shared by EY (3rd-4th floors) and Trilegal (6th-7th floors).

techParks.name: Maruthi Infotech Centre
techParks.locality: Domlur / Amarjyoti Layout (Koramangala-Indiranagar Intermediate Ring Road)
techParks.description: Office centre at 11/1-12/1 Amarjyoti Layout on the Intermediate Ring Road between Koramangala and Indiranagar; A Block hosts Unacademy's registered headquarters and B Wing Licious's; the point is the layout centroid, not the building.

techParks.name: MFAR Wilshire III
techParks.description: MFAR's office tower at RHB Colony, Mahadevapura, off the Whitefield Road; Scripbox's registered and corporate office is on its 5th floor. Coordinates and bbox are the OSM polygon.

techParks.name: Mittal Tower
techParks.description: Older office tower at 47/6 MG Road near Trinity Circle; HSBC's MG Road branch is recorded by OSM just beside it. No large tenant verified.

techParks.name: Narayana Health City
techParks.description: Narayana Health's flagship hospital campus and headquarters on Hosur Road at Bommasandra, holding the Narayana Institute of Cardiac Sciences and the Mazumdar Shaw Medical Center at 258/A Bommasandra Industrial Area; Narayana Nethralaya and Sparsh hospitals are mapped beside it. The bbox is that of the OSM 'Narayana Hrudayalaya' polygon.

techParks.name: NetApp Bangalore Campus
techParks.description: NetApp's own 15-acre campus at Hoodi on ITPL Main Road, opened 2017 as its Global Center of Excellence with capacity for about 3,300 people.

techParks.name: Nethra Tech Park
techParks.description: Small office building in the EPIP Industrial Area at Kundalahalli village; a business directory and an OSM POI place a Collins Aerospace office here.

techParks.name: North Gate Business Park
techParks.description: Three-phase office park on Bellary Road (NH 44) at Yelahanka, opposite the car dealerships strip; Phases 1 and 2 are operational and Phase 3 under construction per OSM. Tenants are from OSM POIs: Collins Aerospace's EDTC and Pratt & Whitney India (both RTX) in Phase 2, an Infosys office, and a WeWork centre in Phase 1. Developer not confirmed; no developer page could be reached.

techParks.name: Novel Tech Park
techParks.description: Small office park on Hosur Road at Kudlu Gate between Ozone Manay Tech Park and AKR Tech Park (OSM way/1257330721); no tenant was confirmed during this run.

techParks.name: Oracle Tech Hub
techParks.description: Oracle's own named campus on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli ORR at Kadubeesanahalli, one block north of Cessna Business Park and about 1.2 km north of ETV; Oracle's India field-office list gives 'Oracle Tech Hub Block C, No.169/1, BBMP Ward No.150-Bellandur'. It is NOT part of Embassy TechVillage, which is why the lens's 'Cerner / Oracle Health?' candidate is recorded under Oracle rather than as an ETV tenant.

techParks.name: Oracle Technology Park
techParks.description: Oracle India's own building on Bannerghatta Main Road immediately north of IBC Knowledge Park, recorded in OSM as 'Oracle Technology Park'; one of Oracle's Bengaluru development sites.

techParks.name: Ozone Manay Tech Park
techParks.description: Mid-rise IT park on the service road of Hosur Road at Garvebhavipalya, mapped in OpenStreetMap as way/1257330725; no tenant could be confirmed from a company page during this run, so the tenant list is left empty.

techParks.name: Peenya Industrial Area
techParks.description: One of Asia's largest industrial areas, laid out from the late 1970s on the Tumkur Road (NH-4) in north-west Bengaluru: about 1,461 acres in four phases hosting some 13,000 MSMEs in machine tools, electrical goods, die-casting, hydraulics and textiles, notified as a Special Investment Region in 2025. Anchors include ABB's campus, Kirloskar Electric's corporate office, Ace Designers, Wipro's hydraulics works and ISRO's ISTRAC mission-control centre.

techParks.name: Prestige Blue Chip
techParks.locality: Koramangala / Adugodi (Hosur Road, Dr M H Marigowda Road)
techParks.description: Prestige Group office block on Hosur Road near the Forum Mall junction; OSM records Barracuda, Computacenter, Tech Mahindra and a Techhub coworking centre here, but these are mapper leads only (Synopsys, also mapped here, has moved to Bagmane Capital).

techParks.name: Prestige Central
techParks.description: Office building at 36 Infantry Road; WeWork India's registered office and Infantry Road centre.

techParks.name: Prestige Centre Point
techParks.description: Office building at 7 Cunningham Road; no tenant verified in this run.

techParks.name: Prestige Emerald
techParks.description: Office building at Municipal No. 2 Madras Bank Road; OSM records Mitsubishi Electric India and Shimizu Corporation.

techParks.name: Prestige Falcon Tower
techParks.description: Office tower at 19 Brunton Road off MG Road; Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas's Bengaluru office.

techParks.name: Prestige Featherlite Tech Park
techParks.locality: Plot 148, EPIP Zone Phase 2, Whitefield Road (Kaveri Nagar / Doddanekundi side)
techParks.description: Small Prestige office building at Plot 148, EPIP Zone, Whitefield Road, opposite KTPO and beside Sattva's Mindcomp Tech Park, marketed largely as serviced/startup space (INR 14,000 per seat per month in one listing). No anchor tenant could be confirmed; OSM places Srijan Technologies inside it. Not to be confused with Prestige Featherlite Tech Hub in Kadubeesanahalli.

techParks.name: Prestige Ferns Galaxy
techParks.description: A single-tenant Prestige office building at Sy. No. 7/1, 7/2, 8/1A Ambalipura, on the Outer Ring Road at the Bellandur Gate / Sarjapur Road junction, occupied by Microsoft India (R&D). It is the address Microsoft prints on Bengaluru offer letters and is Microsoft's largest ORR site; IndiQube Edge and Primeco The Hub are the neighbouring buildings.

techParks.name: Prestige Khoday Tower
techParks.description: Grade-A office tower at 5 Raj Bhavan Road next to Cubbon Park; OSM records The Executive Centre and Frauscher Sensor Technology as tenants.

techParks.name: Prestige Lakeshore Drive
techParks.description: Prestige office development on the Bellandur lakefront off the ORR (phase 2 under construction per OSM); an OSM 'Uber' POI falls inside it, the only location evidence for Uber's Bengaluru tech hub.

techParks.name: Prestige Loka
techParks.description: Office building at 202 Brunton Road; OSM records SatSure, KaleidEO and DSK Legal.

techParks.name: Prestige Meridian
techParks.description: Pair of office towers at 29-30 MG Road; historically Citibank's Bengaluru branch (now Axis Bank after the 2023 consumer-business sale) and a cluster of OSM-recorded insurers and mutual funds.

techParks.name: Prestige Minsk Square
techParks.description: Prestige's newest CBD office building at Municipal No. 6 Cubbon Road; Apple India's registered office since it left UB City.

techParks.name: Prestige Nebula
techParks.description: Office building at 12 Queen's Road / Cubbon Road, part of the Prestige cluster around Minsk Square; no tenant verified in this run.

techParks.name: Prestige Obelisk
techParks.description: Office tower at 3 Kasturba Road opposite Cubbon Park; OSM records JSA, Livspace, Indeed, Infor, Rockwell Automation, Allergan and ICICI Venture here.

techParks.name: Prestige RMZ Startech
techParks.description: Three-wing (A/B/C) IT park on Hosur Road at the Koramangala Industrial Layout, behind the Forum Mall stretch; Wing C is the 'Ola Campus' that ANI Technologies, Ola Electric and Krutrim all give as their registered headquarters, and OSM maps an Accenture delivery centre (BDC-14) in Wing A.

techParks.name: Prestige Shantiniketan
techParks.description: Prestige's integrated township on Whitefield Main Road at Hoodi whose business precinct has about 3.2 million sq ft of offices in seven towers (six forming a crescent-shaped building, plus Tower C near the Nexus Shantiniketan mall). ExxonMobil's Bengaluru technology centre occupies large parts of Crescent 1 and Crescent 2 (0.531 msf renewed Nov 2023-Oct 2028) and Tata Elxsi has an office in Crescent 4.

techParks.name: Prestige Sterling Square
techParks.description: Small Prestige office building off Lavelle Road; OSM records Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas and Nexus Venture Partners.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Cloud
techParks.description: A 33-acre, seven-tower office campus by Prestige on Bellary Road (NH-44) about 7 km south of Kempegowda airport (towers include Cirrus, Cumulus, Altus, Stratus and Arcus). Walmart Global Tech leased ~1 lakh sq ft in Cumulus from March 2026, and NTT's Bengaluru 4 data-centre campus (up to 100 MW) is on the same site.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Pacific Park
techParks.description: A three-block Prestige office cluster beside the Aloft hotel inside the Cessna Business Park precinct, mapped in OSM as Prestige Tech Pacific Park (Blocks 1-3). Walmart Labs / Walmart Global Tech POIs sit in Block 1 and Bazaarvoice Technology India in Block 3; Walmart job postings name 'Pardhanani Wilshire II, Cessna Business Park', which is likely this frontage. No primary source for the park itself could be fetched, so tenants here are OSM-evidenced.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Park
techParks.description: Prestige Group's flagship office campus on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli stretch of the Outer Ring Road at Kadubeesanahalli, built in four phases (I-IV) of roughly twelve towers; the first phase (Building 1, East and West Wings) was built to JPMorgan Chase's specification and is still JPMorgan's main Bengaluru building, and the later star-named blocks (Etamin, Elnath, Electra, Mercury, Venus, Jupiter) were marketed as Exora Business Park. Phase IV (Cosmos, Vector, Velocity, Valence) sits on the western edge beside Helios Business Park. Sizes quoted by secondary sources conflict (about 9 acres across phases vs a '45-acre ecosystem' for phase IV), so no area is recorded.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Platina
techParks.description: Prestige's two-block office development on the Outer Ring Road frontage at the north-east corner of the Prestige Tech Park campus (Cushman & Wakefield lists Block 2 as about 457,000 sq ft, completed 2015). Adobe's own offices page gives 'Prestige Platina Technology Park, Building 1, Block A, Bangalore 560103' as one of its two Bengaluru addresses. Coordinates are the mid-point of the two unnamed 'Block 1'/'Block 2' office footprints on Outer Ring Road in OSM that carry the Adobe POIs; the block-to-footprint mapping is inferred, not mapped.

techParks.name: Prestige Technopolis
techParks.locality: Adugodi / Dairy Circle (Dr M H Marigowda Road)
techParks.description: A Prestige office building on Dr M H Marigowda Road at Adugodi near Dairy Circle; Accenture's official location list includes it (OpenStreetMap labels the site Accenture BDC-9).

techParks.name: Prestige Technostar
techParks.locality: Doddanekundi Industrial Area 2, Phase 1, Brookefield (ITPL Main Road)
techParks.description: Prestige Group's ~8.5-acre, ~10.5 lakh sq ft office park on ITPL Main Road in the Doddanekundi Industrial Area, with B1-B3 blocks, food courts and The Executive Centre's serviced offices on Level 8 of B3. Tenant disclosure is thin; AMD, o9 Solutions and Netskope are mapped inside it on OSM.

techParks.name: Prestige Terminus
techParks.locality: Konena Agrahara, HAL Old Airport Road (opposite HAL)
techParks.description: Two Prestige office blocks on the Airport Arrival Road spur off HAL Old Airport Road, next to the old HAL airport terminal. Recorded in OSM; no tenant could be substantiated in this pass.

techParks.name: Prestige Trade Tower
techParks.description: Prestige's high-rise office tower on Palace Road in the central business district; OpenStreetMap records the Deloitte India office here (the POI is named 'Prestige Deloitte').

techParks.name: Purva Premiere
techParks.description: Office building at 135 Residency Road; Unisys's Bengaluru centre per OSM.

techParks.name: Raheja Arcade
techParks.description: Commercial complex in Koramangala 560095 that Tally Solutions gives as its registered office (Nos. 331-336).

techParks.name: Raheja Towers
techParks.description: 1990s twin office block at 26-27 MG Road; OSM mappers record Standard Chartered's branch, Regus, HCL Infosystems, JSW Steel and several insurers here.

techParks.name: Rajajinagar IT Park
techParks.description: A small Karnataka State Small Industries Development Corporation IT/BT park inside the Rajajinagar Industrial Estate on Chord Road; ABB India's Bengaluru engineering office (Plot 1-4, 18th A Main) is its known anchor. Mapped as a commercial landuse in OSM (way 781588921).

techParks.name: RGA Tech Park
techParks.description: A 2.2 million sq ft, four-block IT/SEZ park on Sarjapur Main Road at Chikkanahalli village near Carmelaram (Plot 13-15), developed by the Kolkata-based RGA group. Listings place Uber and PayPal in Blocks 1-2, Siemens in Block 2, Unisys and LTTS in Block 3 and Accenture in Block 4; RGA's own client list adds HP, Intuit, Societe Generale, Capgemini and Genpact without mapping them to blocks. Cerner/Oracle Health and Visa were NOT found here. Polygon from OSM way/460960666.

techParks.name: RMZ Centennial
techParks.description: RMZ's office campus at Kundalahalli on the ITPL Main Road; OpenStreetMap records a WNS delivery centre here.

techParks.name: RMZ Ecoworld
techParks.description: The largest office campus on the Bellandur stretch of ORR, established 2016 on about 48 acres with 15 completed Grade-A blocks (Campus 1-9, each split into A/B/C/D towers) and 7.7 million sq ft of leasable space, 94% committed as of Brookfield's FY2026 note; it is the single largest asset in the Brookfield India REIT. RMZ's own newer phases, Ecoworld 20 (where Disney leased floors 6-7 in 2026) and Ecoworld 30 (Campus 30-33, 3.55 million sq ft in four towers, home to Ryan, Haleon and several flexible-office operators), carry the same name. Key occupiers named by the owner are Honeywell, Morgan Stanley, Shell, KPMG, Deloitte, State Street, Standard Chartered and Cadence; Capgemini, KPIT, BT, Allstate, Virtusa and BCG also give Ecoworld addresses. Centroid and bbox are derived from the OSM building polygons for Campus 1-9 and 30-33, because OSM has no landuse polygon for the park itself.

techParks.name: RMZ Futura
techParks.description: Two-block RMZ office campus on Bannerghatta Road at Arekere; OSM records HSBC and Accenture offices inside it, neither confirmed by a company or lease source.

techParks.name: RMZ Galleria
techParks.description: RMZ's mixed-use Galleria at Yelahanka on Bellary Road: a mall, residences and an Office Block whose 10th-12th floors house Comviva's main Bengaluru office.

techParks.name: RMZ Infinity
techParks.description: Five-tower (A-E) RMZ office campus at No.3 Old Madras Road beside Benniganahalli and the Swami Vivekananda Road metro station. Google's own locations page lists its 'Old Madras Road' office here and Calix lists Tower B; OSM also records LSEG, EY, Alcon, Analog Devices and Thomson Reuters floors. Sabre, Wells Fargo and Kotak were suggested by the lens prompt but could not be confirmed here (Sabre now lists ITPB, Wells Fargo maps to Embassy TechVillage).

techParks.name: RMZ Latitude
techParks.developer: RMZ Corp (portfolio acquired by Brookfield Properties, 2020)
techParks.description: Office complex on Bellary Road, Hebbal (near the Godrej apartments): RMZ Latitude Commercial with a WeWork on the 10th floor, and the adjacent 'Azure' tower that OSM attributes to Brookfield Properties, where OSM places Alcon, Mott MacDonald, Dayforce (Ceridian), Enercon and Boeing offices. Only the WeWork is confirmed from a primary page.

techParks.name: RMZ Millenia
techParks.description: Two-tower RMZ business park on Murphy Road, Ulsoor, next to the Israeli consulate. The only tenant evidenced in this pass is TMEIC's Bengaluru branch (OSM); the Deloitte, Oracle, Fidelity, Goldman Sachs and Ericsson names suggested for it could not be confirmed (their evidenced Bengaluru offices are elsewhere).

techParks.name: RMZ NXT
techParks.description: RMZ office campus at 2A/2B Sonnenahalli village on ITPL Main Road, immediately west of the SAP Labs campus; SAP Labs India lists it as its second Whitefield-side site.

techParks.name: RMZ Titanium
techParks.description: RMZ office building at 135 HAL Old Airport Road, Kodihalli, opposite the Leela Palace. OSM nodes from 2015 name GKN Aerospace, FICO (Fair Isaac), CA Technologies, Amber Road, AmiCorp and Hyder Consulting as tenants, but none could be confirmed from company pages and several have since been acquired or moved, so no tenant is asserted.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Magnificia
techParks.description: Salarpuria Sattva office block at 78 Old Madras Road (Swamy Vivekananda Road) near Tin Factory junction, Benniganahalli. OSM places OSB India, a Sattva office and a (possibly former) WeWork centre here and KreditBee just west of it; WeWork India's current Bengaluru list no longer names Old Madras Road. Pin is the OSM WeWork POI; no polygon is drawn.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Eminence
techParks.description: Office building on Panathur Main Road behind Prestige Tech Park; OSM pins a Myntra office inside it.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Knowledge Court
techParks.description: Sattva Group office campus on the Marathahalli-Brookefield side of the Outer Ring Road, just north of the Marathahalli bridge (Sattva's own site files it under Brookefield). OSM records Harman's India corporate headquarters, WNS and Netskope India inside the campus; none of the three companies' location pages could be fetched, so these tenants are OSM-evidenced only.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Mindcomp Tech Park
techParks.locality: EPIP Zone Phase 2, Whitefield Road (Kaveri Nagar / Doddanekundi side)
techParks.description: Completed Salarpuria Sattva office park ('Sattva Mindcomp Tech Park, Whitefield' on the developer's project list) on the EPIP Zone frontage of Whitefield Road, adjoining Prestige Featherlite Tech Park and the STT data centre. No tenant could be confirmed from a primary or press source; Microchip Technology's Plot 149-B office lies on its edge.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Softzone
techParks.locality: Bellandur / Green Glen Layout, Sarjapur-ORR junction
techParks.description: Multi-block Salarpuria Sattva office complex (Blocks A/B, Nos. 80/1, 81/1, 81/2) on the ORR service road at Green Glen Layout, Bellandur, beside the Sarjapur Road junction. PhonePe's registered HQ (Block A) and JFrog India (B Block) are confirmed from their own sites; OSM additionally tags HSBC, Dell, Genpact, SAP, National Instruments, AT&T and Brocade here, unverified. Polygon from OSM way/232329241.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Touchstone
techParks.description: Two-block (A and B) Sattva office building at 15/1A Outer Ring Road, Kadubeesanahalli, wedged between Helios Business Park and the Aricent/Capgemini campus. Walmart Global Tech lists '3rd Floor, Block B, Salarpuria Touchstone' as a Bengaluru office; OSM records Lumen (and its CenturyLink/Savvis predecessors), Riverbed and a Smartworks coworking centre here.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Windsor
techParks.description: Office building at 3 Ulsoor Road; Sattva Group's corporate office.

techParks.name: SAP Labs India Campus
techParks.description: SAP Labs India's owner-occupied main campus at #138 EPIP Zone, Whitefield (blocks A-E plus later buildings), the company's largest R&D hub outside Germany until the second Devanahalli campus opened in August 2025. SAP also lists an RMZ NXT site in nearby Mahadevapura.

techParks.name: SAP Labs India Innovation Park
techParks.description: SAP Labs India's 41-acre second Bengaluru campus in the KIADB IT sector near the airport, inaugurated 5 Aug 2025; 27 acres built in phase 1, ~15,000 seats at full build-out, phase 2 targeted for 2028.

techParks.name: Sattva Horizon
techParks.description: Sattva Group's office building on Bellary Road at Yelahanka, between North Gate Business Park and Hinduja Ecopolis; OSM records an Amazon office in it (unverified).

techParks.name: Sattva Spectrum
techParks.description: New Grade A office tower by Sattva Group 'next to Wipro office on Sarjapura Road' at Kaikondrahalli, listed as an ongoing project on the developer's commercial page; the only 2024-26 Sarjapur Road campus that could be verified. No tenants announced. Polygon from OSM way/1089707942.

techParks.name: Shell Technology Centre Bangalore
techParks.locality: KIADB Hardware Park (SEZ), Mahadevakodigehalli, Bagalur / Devanahalli
techParks.description: Shell's 52-acre, purpose-built R&D campus near Kempegowda International Airport, opened March 2017 for up to 1,500 scientists and engineers, consolidating Bengaluru teams previously spread across the city; one of Shell's three global technology hubs (with Amsterdam and Houston).

techParks.name: Shilpa Emerald
techParks.description: Office building at 26/1 Hosur Main Road 560068 beside AMR Tech Park; Softtek's Bangalore office.

techParks.name: Shilpitha Tech Park
techParks.description: Compact tech-office building on Outer Ring Road at Devarabisanahalli, opposite Sakra World Hospital, best known as Shadowfax Technologies' registered and corporate office (3rd floor). OSM polygon centroid.

techParks.name: Sigma Soft Tech Park
techParks.locality: Ramagondanahalli / Varthur Kodi, Whitefield Main Road
techParks.description: A four-tower IT park (Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta) at No. 7 Whitefield Main Road, Ramagondanahalli / Varthur Kodi, south of Whitefield; a listing gives about 835,000 sq ft built-up. Occupiers are mostly small and mid-size firms by registry address (Embitel Technologies in Delta, ATI Accurate Technologies India in Alpha, Mercatus Commerce in Gamma), and GoodWorks runs a coworking floor.

techParks.name: SJR Cyber
techParks.description: Mid-rise commercial block at 22 Laskar Hosur Road, Adugodi, between the Forum Mall and Koramangala; Razorpay's headquarters since 2018.

techParks.name: SJR iPark
techParks.description: SJR Prime Corporation's office park in the EPIP Zone, Whitefield (Mobius and Warp towers in OSM), near the Kundalahalli ORR junction. It lies in the Whitefield belt rather than the Kadubeesanahalli stretch; the developer's domain is now parked and no tenant could be verified from a fetchable source, so the tenant list is left empty.

techParks.name: SJR Primeco The Hub
techParks.description: Office building ('The Hub') by SJR Primeco on Sarjapur Main Road beside Vaishnavi Tech Park; Udaan (Hiveloop Technology) is headquartered in the South Wing.

techParks.name: SJR Primeco Union City
techParks.description: SJR Primeco's office complex on ITPL Main Road, Whitefield, next to Prestige Shantiniketan; Block B hosts Plum Benefits (6th floor). OSM polygon centroid and bbox.

techParks.name: SKAV 909
techParks.description: Boutique office building on Lavelle Road; OSM records MiQ, athenahealth, Awfis and (formerly) Bain and Tesla India here.

techParks.name: Subramanya Arcade
techParks.locality: Bannerghatta Road, N.A.L Layout (near Dairy Circle)
techParks.description: Office complex at No.12 Bannerghatta Main Road 560029 that IBM gives as its India corporate address; OSM maps three IBM buildings in it.

techParks.name: Sumadhura Capitol Towers
techParks.description: Sumadhura's office-and-retail project on 8.67 acres near Hope Farm Junction with about 1.5 million sq ft leasable. In 2025 Sumadhura reported leasing ~5 lakh sq ft to First Brands Group, Terex India and Saiharmony Solutions; Swiggy moved its Bengaluru headquarters here in April 2026 (about 2,000 staff), and an OSM POI places BMW TechWorks India in Tower 2.

techParks.name: TCS Think Campus
techParks.locality: Electronics City Phase 2, Shantipura Main Road
techParks.description: Tata Consultancy Services' Bengaluru flagship campus in Electronics City Phase 2, mapped in OpenStreetMap as way/188314420 with its entrance on Shantipura Main Road; Wikipedia's Electronic City article names TCS's main campus among the township's anchors.

techParks.name: Technology Innovation International Park
techParks.description: A planned technology park by CDC Development India, approved at Rs 740 crore with 100 acres allotted in the Devanahalli aerospace / hi-tech park area; OSM maps it as a construction site north of SAP's campus. No tenants found.

techParks.name: The Estate
techParks.description: Office building at 121 Dickenson Road off MG Road; OSM records Havells India, ACC, Mitsubishi Elevators and Razorfish among its tenants (unverified).

techParks.name: The Pavilion
techParks.description: Office building at 62/63 Church Street run as a WeWork centre.

techParks.name: Titanium Tech Park
techParks.description: An office campus in the Kadugodi industrial belt east of ITPB. Airbus leased an entire building here (reported as 650,000 sq ft over 10 years, Dec 2024; CRE Matrix separately records a 1.51 lakh sq ft lease to Oct 2034) for the Airbus India Technology Centre inaugurated in March 2026, and an OSM POI places Caterpillar's Cat Digital office here.

techParks.name: Trifecta Adatto
techParks.description: Office tower at No.21 ITPL Main Road, Garudachar Palya, on the KR Puram-Mahadevapura border. Quantiphi's contact page confirms its Bengaluru office here and OSM records a McKinsey service centre (and a Flipkart office, not asserted).

techParks.name: UB City
techParks.description: Bengaluru's flagship CBD development (completed 2008, >1.6 million sq ft) with four office towers - UB Tower, Canberra, Concorde and Comet/Kingfisher - over The Collection luxury mall; home to the UB/Diageo spirits HQs and several strategy and audit firms.

techParks.name: Umiya Emporium
techParks.locality: Adugodi / Tavarekere (Hosur Road, opposite Forum Mall)
techParks.description: Office building at 97-99 Hosur Road directly opposite Forum Mall; Wakefit Innovations' registered headquarters (2nd and 4th floors).

techParks.name: Vaishnavi Silicon Terraces
techParks.description: Office complex at 30/1 Hosur Main Road, Koramangala; BRND.ME (formerly Mensa Brands) gives Tower A as its headquarters.

techParks.name: Vaishnavi Tech Park
techParks.description: Vaishnavi Group's three-tower (North, Central, South) office park on Sarjapur Road at Bellandur Gate, a few hundred metres from Prestige Ferns Galaxy and the ORR junction. Vaishnavi's website renders its project list client-side and no tenant could be verified from a fetchable source; OSM has only small firms (Odessa, Khosla Labs) and an Uber POI on the park's southern edge, none confirmed, so the tenant list is left empty rather than guessed.

techParks.name: Vaishnavi Tech Square
techParks.description: A single Vaishnavi office building off 6th Main Road, Iblur, on the Sarjapur-side service road of the ORR near the Iblur junction. OSM records Navi (Sachin Bansal's Navi Technologies) here, consistent with Navi's published registered address; Navi's site refused the fetch, so this remains OSM-evidenced.

techParks.name: Velankani Tech Park
techParks.locality: 43, Electronics City Phase 1, Hosur Main Road
techParks.description: Velankani Group's own IT park at #43 Electronic City Phase 1, Hosur Main Road, housing the group's IT and hospitality businesses including The Oterra hotel (OSM places 'The Oterra Bengaluru Electronics City' inside the polygon).

techParks.name: Vigyan
techParks.description: Standalone office building at 9 Lavelle Road long occupied by Microsoft India (R&D).

techParks.name: WeWork Galaxy
techParks.description: Former Galaxy cinema site at 43 Residency Road, rebuilt as a WeWork flagship and the CBD's best-known startup coworking address.

techParks.name: WeWork Prestige Atlanta
techParks.description: WeWork coworking centre in the Prestige Atlanta building on 80 Feet Road, Koramangala 1A Block; listed on WeWork India's Bangalore page. Neighbouring buildings house slice (Ashford Park View) and Instamojo (Ma Grace).

techParks.name: WeWork Prestige Cube
techParks.description: WeWork coworking centre in Prestige Cube at 26 Hosur Road, Adugodi, beside the Forum Mall; listed on WeWork India's Bangalore page and mapped by OSM.

techParks.name: WeWork Salarpuria Symbiosis
techParks.description: Salarpuria Sattva office building on Bannerghatta Road at Arekere run as a WeWork managed campus (football pitch, gym), about 5 minutes from Fortis Hospital and Royal Meenakshi Mall.

techParks.name: WeWork Vaishnavi Signature
techParks.locality: Bellandur (Outer Ring Road, Green Glen Layout)
techParks.description: WeWork coworking centre in the Vaishnavi Signature building on the Outer Ring Road at Bellandur, listed on WeWork India's Bangalore page.

techParks.name: Whitefield Palms
techParks.locality: EPIP Zone Phase 1, Whitefield Main Road
techParks.description: Office campus at Plot Nos. 9 & 10, Whitefield Main Road, EPIP Phase 1, which is the registered visitor and postal address of Mercedes-Benz R&D India and of Daimler Truck Innovation Center India.

techParks.name: Wipro Electronic City Campus
techParks.description: Wipro's multi-tower Electronics City delivery campus (EC1, EC2/3 with its Learning Centre and Executive Briefing Centre, and EC4 across the road), mapped in OpenStreetMap as Towers 1-23 along Wipro Avenue; Wikipedia's Electronic City article names it among the township's main campuses.

techParks.name: Wipro Kodathi SEZ
techParks.description: Wipro's second Sarjapur Road campus, a 50-acre SEZ at Kodathi village about 6 km south-east of the HQ, planned at ~2 million sq ft for 30,000+ staff when announced in 2018 and listed on Wipro's locations page as the Kodathi Development Center (Survey No. 91/1, 98 & 99). Polygon from OSM way/635317794.

techParks.name: Wipro SEZ Sarjapur
techParks.description: Wipro's global corporate headquarters campus on Sarjapur Road at Doddakannelli, about 1 km south of the Sarjapur-ORR junction: the SJP1 corporate office plus the adjoining SJP2 SEZ development centre. Owner-occupied; the Azim Premji Foundation sits next door. Polygon from OSM way/370327479 with SJP2 at way/230229162.

techParks.name: World Trade Center Bengaluru (Brigade Gateway)
techParks.description: The 128 m, 32-storey World Trade Center Bengaluru (completed 2010, WTCA-licensed, ~1.1 million sq ft with 40,000 sq ft floor plates) anchors Brigade Gateway, Brigade Group's 40-acre mixed-use enclave on Dr Rajkumar Road with Orion Mall, Sheraton Grand, Manipal Hospital, Brigade School and 1,200+ flats. The low-rise WTC Annexe (over 1 lakh sq ft, home to Brigade's BuzzWorks managed offices since March 2024) stands beside it. Amazon India has held ~18 floors since opening but announced in Nov 2024 a move to a Sattva site near the airport.

techParks.name: Yelahanka Industrial Estate
techParks.description: KIADB/KHB industrial estate at Yelahanka New Town, next to the Rail Wheel Factory: Centum Electronics' head office (44 KHB Industrial Area), Cargill's Provimi animal-nutrition unit and the former SLK Software (now Altimetrik) site.

provenance.note: Merged by tools/data/merge.py from the research slices in data/raw/. Office coordinates come from OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via Nominatim/Photon/Overpass or from the park's centroid; see each office's evidence line.
